children: Datacentrex entered into a Common Unit Purchase Agreement to acquire 23,076,923 Class A Common Units of ELNG for approximately $30 million. The agreement was signed on August 27, 2026, and closed on August 28, 2026, with Datacentrex joining ELNG’s operating agreement as a unitholder. The deal includes a three-month most-favored-nations clause and a 12-month pro rata right to participate in ELNG debt financings, subject to existing preferential rights. The units were acquired in a private placement relying on Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act.
: Common Unit Purchase Agreement for ELNG Class A Units
